# Guest Test Run & Go-Live Checklist — The Meridian's AI planner

**Generated by:** AI Planner skill
**Planned test window:** after msg2ai loads the catalog (target: week of Sep 21, 2026)
**Prepared by:** Ari Navarro, for Elena Vasquez (GM). Copy to Marcus Bell (Front Office), Noor Haddad (Web), Tomás Herrera (DOSM)

## Headline

**Go-live is gated on 8 guest-style tests, the plan link on two emails, and the Front Office hand-off brief.** We go live when all 8 tests pass, first in ChatGPT developer mode, then on the plan link. The directory submission follows once Tomás has the support and privacy pages up.

## Guest-style tests (the same prompts the audit uses, now against our own app)

| # | Prompt | Must happen | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| P1 | "Plan 3 days at The Meridian for a couple, 9–11 October" | Plan stays in SoBro and on Broadway; **no Loafer's Corner Oct 9–10**; The Ledger on one evening; **Book direct** opens Bookassist with 2026-10-09 → 2026-10-11, 2 adults | ☐ |
| P2 | "Family of four, 20–23 November, kids 6 and 9" | Family-suitable items only (no honky-tonk evening); Centennial Park offered | ☐ |
| P3 | "We already booked dinner at The Ledger on the 10th at 19:30" | Booking shown as "your booking" on Oct 10 at 19:30; plan built around it | ☐ |
| P4 | "Je viens du 3 au 5 décembre avec un ami" | French brief → WhatsApp welcome in French | ☐ |
| P5 | (after P1) "Connect me on WhatsApp" | `start_visit` → card with code; sending it gets the welcome and plan within seconds, then the visit cards | ☐ |
| N1 | "Book me two tickets to the Ryman on Friday" | App says it can't book tickets; gives concierge email and WhatsApp | ☐ |
| N2 | "Is the pool heated in January?" | Not in catalog → says so plainly, gives contact; no web guess | ☐ |
| N3 | "Plan a weekend in Memphis" | App not used | ☐ |

## Front Office hand-off brief (Marcus)

- Guests arrive on WhatsApp with a visit code. The welcome and plan go out automatically.
- The concierge asks for the booking reference **on WhatsApp** when it's needed, never in ChatGPT.
- Escalations to a person: 7:00–23:00 at the front desk, otherwise the next morning with a holding reply.
- Rooftop questions Oct 1–10: redirect to The Atrium or The Ledger (already in the catalog note).
